HeaderControls.note: Trigger in its real home — the settings scope-tab right slot, beside the Cloud|Local SegmentedControl. Outline trigger, GitHub mark, truncating name and the chevrons affordance all read correctly.

CloudRepoSelected.note: Cloud-kind selection swaps the GitHub mark for the Cloud glyph; caption states the rule. Styled and plausible.

OpenMenu.note: The popover is photographed open (the trigger is clicked on mount — RepoPicker does not forward PopoverButton's private open state). Shows all four items with icon/label/detail, the check on the selected row, the hairline divider and the 'Add repository…' footer.

SingleRepository.note: value={null} falling back to the first item, the documented default. Renders identically to a chosen repo, which is the correct behaviour.
